main.name: Jackie (Jingkai) Shao
main.bio:
Hey there! My name is Jackie and I am a Mechanical Engineering Student at the University of Waterloo. I grew up in Montreal where I was a pilot, aviation flight safety enthusiast, and basketball player among many other things. In 2025, I left to explore my passion towards science and the engineering field at Waterloo.

Passionate about innovation, design and creative freedom, I've the pleasure of developing a wide variety of skills and experience across automotive and aerospace industries. These projects encapsulate some of the work that I have done within those industries as well as additional personal projects.

Feel free to reach out and ask me anything I have done. I would love to have a conversation and will get back to you as quickly as I can!

education.degree: Bachelor of Applied Science in Mechanical Engineering
education.description: Honours Program with Co-op. Relevant Coursework: Engineering Design, C++ Programming, Material Science, Electrical Circuits, Mechanics, CFD/FEA Workshop

work.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern
work.description: Filament Winding automation using RAPID and KUKA Robot Language (KRL) for hydrogen mobility vessels.

work.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
work.description: Designed SolidWorks 3D models and AutoCAD 2D drawings for bulk storage tanks. Conducted pipeline stress analysis and conjugate heat transfer analysis.

work.title: Mechanical Engineering Intern
work.description: Designed CATIA 3D models for thermoplastic liners used in Type IV hydrogen mobility vessels. Developed Digital Twin Robotic Arm in KUKA.Sim.

projects.title: Open Duck Mini
projects.about: In progress — building a miniature, 3D-printed version of Disney's BDX droid (about 42 cm tall, under $400 BOM) that walks using reinforcement learning, based on the open-source Open Duck Mini project.

projects.title: Humanoid Robot
projects.about: In progress — modifying the open-source AlohaMini dual-arm mobile robot for Micron Technology's Robotics & Manufacturing Automation team, for use in the warehouse and the CR1, CR2, CR3, and Post Electrical sections of the assembly and testing production line in MXA.

projects.title: Automation Digital Brain
projects.about: In progress — a unified project-execution, engineering-knowledge, and AI-agent web app for Micron Technology's Robotics & Manufacturing Automation team, meant to replace checking across all its other existing software. Currently connecting the AI agent panel to real agent logic.

projects.title: GV-01
projects.about: In progress, very early stage — a WATFlight sustainable aviation vehicle project. Currently writing the Engineering Design Specification document.

projects.title: Quad-X-Cage (A quadcopter built for Indoor Inspection)
projects.about: X-frame quadrotor platform featuring enclosed propeller cages, central avionics stack, and modular landing gear designed for indoor inspection of warehouses, factories, and infrastructure.

projects.title: Tooling Design (Jigs & Fixtures)
projects.about: Designed a jig with spring-loaded hold-down clamps (DFA) in SolidWorks, eliminating the need for threaded fasteners. Also designed a fixture with single-motion clamping instead of a screw-down clamp (DFM), reducing manufacturing cost by 10%.

projects.title: Cryogenics Systems Modeling
projects.about: Designed a 3D Model of LNG Cryogenic Storage Tank in SolidWorks with instrumentation panels (HMI + gauges) and piping functions (valves + regulators + reliefs), providing clear visualization to clients and technicians.

projects.title: Filament Winding Robotic Arm Digital Twin
projects.about: Developed a Digital Twin Robotic Arm in KUKA.Sim to perform a Gage R&R study on fibre winding angle, improving the measurement accuracy of the rotary encoders by 10%.

projects.title: WATFlight Launch Control Center
projects.about: Full-stack task-management platform for the WATFlight design team: a Kanban board per sub-team with drag-and-drop, realtime Supabase-backed collaboration, and row-level security.

testimonials.text: Jackie's technical expertise in CAD/CAE and automation has been instrumental in improving our manufacturing processes.
An exceptional engineer who combines strong analytical skills with practical manufacturing knowledge.
